sourceDescription: NMC letter D-11011/500/2024-AcademicCell dated 12-09-2024 with CBME Curriculum 2024 and competency volumes; General Surgery (CODE: SU) table read at text offsets 600000-700000 of 801400.
verification: Official NMC document text read through a web reader that quotes short rows and restates long rows. PDF bytes, the pinned SHA-256, sourceBodySha256 values, rendered pages and table-cell alignment were not independently verified. Identity of this file with the pinned source PDF is assumed from title and date, not proven. No source prose stored.
modeRule: Practical draft mode expected when the official level is SH or P; knowledge mode otherwise. Two documented exceptions (SU4.1, SU10.3).
scope: All 116 Surgery references that lacked selected review evidence at the checked head (SU1.1-SU30.6; SU3.2, SU22.3, SU28.5, SU28.18 and SU30.4 already reviewed).
observations: The reader found SU24.1-SU24.3 (pancreas) and SU27.1-SU27.8 (vascular and lymphatic) in the official table without Topic 24 or Topic 27 headings; none is in the names-only index. These match the 11 Surgery heading exceptions in the separate source-exception track and are not reviewed here.
The reader reported no SU26.2 in the official table.
Reader reported every SU row as Core and no certification counts.
limits: Editorial scope comparison only; no clinical, faculty, rights or canonical acceptance.
The 154-reference original hold inventory is unchanged.
